definitions.explanation: the price at which something is sold to customers

examples.japanese: {売値|うりね}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{千|せん}{円|えん}→千円：08980_senen⟧です。
⟦{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}→仕入れ値：21592_shiirene⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{売値|うりね}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The difference between the purchase price and selling price becomes profit.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{売値|うりね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げない→下げる：00807_sageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{売|う}れない→売れる：02012_ureru⟧⟦かもしれない→かもしれない：00164_kamoshirenai⟧。
examples.english: We might not sell this product unless we lower the selling price.

notes:
{売値|うりね} is a business term for the selling price or retail price of a product.

WRITING:
- ⟦{売|う}り→売り：12159_uri⟧ (selling)
- ⟦{値|ね}→値：03527_ne⟧ (price, value)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売値|うりね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to set a selling price)
- {売値|うりね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to lower the selling price)
- {売値|うりね}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to determine the selling price)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {買値|かいね} (purchase price, buying price)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仕入|しい}れ{値|ね}→仕入れ値：21592_shiirene⟧ (wholesale/purchase price)
- ⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧ (list price)
- ⟦{原価|げんか}→原価：05470_genka⟧ (cost price)
- ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧ (retail price - more formal)
